title: Stagehold. Payment follows proof. Here is the full flow, recorded live on GenLayer Studionet.
Landing: Stagehold holds a construction payment in escrow, and releases it stage by stage.
Payer console: The payer names the builder, sets a small fee per attempt, and creates a job.
Deploying the job contract: That deploys a fresh contract on GenLayer.
Fund roof stage with anchor photo: Next, the payer funds the roof stage in GEN, with an anchor photo of the site.
Funding the escrow: The money is now locked in escrow.
Issue code: The payer issues a short code, to be written on the work.
Builder opens the job link: The builder opens the job link, in a separate browser, with a separate account.
Registering this browser's signing key: They register a signing key for this job.
Adding attempt credits: And add credits, to pay the small fee for each attempt.
Live camera: The photo must come from the live camera. No gallery uploads, and software cameras are refused.
The validator panel is judging: The code is on the work. Now independent GenLayer validators, each running its own model, decide whether the stage is complete, and the code is visible.
Stage paid: Both answers are yes. The builder is paid when the result is final. There is no release button.
Payer sees it paid: The escrow is empty, and the payer never had to approve anything.
end: Built on GenLayer. Payment follows proof. The camera in this recording was a stand-in feed, and the waits were sped up.
